1.1: Welcome to Tiling Forest, the demo version of Tiling Town!

2.1:
When you complete an Area, you obtain a new tile.
Complete the next Area with the new tile!

3.2: Refer to the @b{Guide} for what to do next.

4.1: You can't reach this road from this Area.
4.2: @b{Move the camera} and look for another road.

5.1: You can also use @i{mouse_scroll} to select the previous or next tile.

6.1:
This concludes the tutorial.
Keep going and complete more Areas!
6.2: There's also a @b{Rules list} where you can check the various rules...
6.3: ...and a feature for placing @b{marks for taking notes}, so make good use of them.

7.1: To complete the Forest, @b{how} you complete each Area also matters.
7.2:
If you want to restore an Area you've changed to the placement it had when you completed it,
the @b{Load Tile Placement} feature is useful.

1.2:
But you haven't fully cleared it yet.
Complete the remaining Areas to complete the Forest!

2.1:
You've finally completed the Forest!

2.2:
If you've made it this far, we're sure you'll enjoy Tiling Town as well.
